# GENERATED BY rpxtool
# Source: rpxtool/mod_data/on_actions.py
on_actions = {

	# on_startup fires ONCE per game in GLOBAL scope (not per-country), so we loop every_country to grant the RPX baseline trait set to every country in the world. Inside every_country, THIS = the country, ROOT = global.
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			every_country = {
				# Pass A: every_country (country scope) accumulates world
				# totals into global.rpx_world_*; the last iteration leaves
				# the true world average for Pass B to read.
				rpx_calc_world_context = yes
			}
			every_country = {
				# Assign national spirits first (development tier
				# deterministically, social character randomly), then grant
				# the dynamic modifiers whose baselines read them.
				rpx_assign_development_spirit = yes
				rpx_assign_social_character = yes
				rpx_assign_admin_character = yes
				rpx_assign_military_character = yes
				rpx_assign_navy_character = yes
				rpx_assign_airforce_character = yes
				rpx_setup_industrial_base = yes
				rpx_setup_economy_health = yes
				rpx_assign_economy_spirit = yes
				rpx_setup_valiant_defense = yes
				rpx_setup_army_state = yes
				rpx_setup_airforce_state = yes
				rpx_setup_navy_state = yes
				rpx_setup_political_state = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# Fires once per month per country (~30 day interval). Each month there is a chance the economy-fluctuation event triggers and nudges the variable that backs rpx_industrial_base. The valiant defence bonus is recomputed here.
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			rpx_update_valiant_defense = yes
			rpx_assign_economy_spirit = yes
		}
	}

}
